cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel it. I'll work in the dark; ask the house to keep your desk lit until five.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs a house request, A3 reduces lighting to B desk and A5 accepts personal darkness to keep B within house negotiation instead of electrical repair.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs practical light and B4 remains reasonably unconvinced by a coincidental response.

heightening.evidence: A5 asks B to abandon the last ordinary repair route while paying its cost in A own workspace.
